in_marathi.name: Musarraf
in_marathi.long_meaning: Musarraf हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Musarraf is derived from the Sanskrit word 'musa' meaning 'musk' and 'rava' meaning 'abundance'. It is a noble and powerful name that represents the strength and courage of nature.
